research_problem: Whether research REST API test-generation techniques scale to and perform in online (production) testing of industrial APIs
technical_approach: Empirical study with RESTest re-architected as a multi-bot system (228 bots); black-box test data strategies (FD, CDG, DP, SD, CD) x test case strategies (RT, CBT, ART); six status-code/spec oracles; NLD-based failure clustering + manual triage
primary_contribution: First industrial-scale online testing study: 13 production APIs, 15 days, 1.1M tests; 254 reproducible bugs (65 acknowledged); 5 adoption challenges; open multi-bot architecture + dataset
dataset_benchmark: 13 industrial APIs (Amadeus, DHL, FDIC, Foursquare, LanguageTool, Marvel, Ohsome, OMDb, RESTCountries, Spotify, Stripe, Yelp, YouTube x2): 189 operations, 1,694 parameters
evaluation_metrics: failures/faults by oracle type; FDR, FtDR; APFD; black-box API coverage (inputs counted only for successful requests)
baselines: None external; internal comparison among bot strategies (explicitly not a rigorous technique comparison)
key_findings: 389,216 failures (1 in 3 tests); 63% are spec-response disconformities (F_OAS); 147 faults in 11 APIs (50% F_OAS, 52 invalid-input-accepted, only 6 server errors); 87% faults found in first 3 days; data perturbation found most unique bugs (55); CBT more cost-effective than RT; ART no gain
author_limitations: Fault clustering imprecise (363 of 502 clusters misclassified); need human-in-the-loop, strategy selection, quota-aware scheduling, resource optimization; FDIC/Ohsome only sampled; RESTest-dependence; 13 APIs may not be representative
analyst_limitations: Oracles cannot detect business-logic errors; F_OAS ambiguity (spec vs implementation fault not separated); strategy comparison confounded by unequal bot counts and budgets; single tool/group; few write operations; NLD thresholds not sensitivity-tested; internal inconsistency 11 vs 12 APIs
reproducibility: Artifact on Zenodo (code, binaries, data, scripts); exact replication impossible because production APIs change; heavy hardware (512GB RAM VM)
suggested_extensions: ML/LLM-based failure triage on the released 390K-failure dataset; quota-aware test scheduling optimization; automatic spec repair from F_OAS failures; semantic/metamorphic oracles in online setting
confidence: High (full text read; tables partially corrupted in conversion)
